reviews.comment: Dr. Depoy's just a chill guy just talking about what he loves. Has 4 exams and 1 final, he only gets your 4 highest. He has in-class pop quizzes but not hard at all. He really just wants you to do good in the class. You can go to "star parties" for 1 point extra credit in your grade.

Professor Depoy is hands down the best professor I've had as an instructor at Texas A&M. His lectures are long, but you only notice on the very few lectures that aren't interesting.  He is really funny and makes the class fun to be in and the tests are easy, only taking an hour or two of studying at the max.

Overall ASTRO 101 was not bad. There are 3 tests and a final, as well as in-class assignments. The lecture notes and test reviews are posted online. There are "Star Parties" that you can go to for 1 point on your overall grade. If you take this class you can at least get a B.

Fun (but long) lectures, no homework, easy tests. Professor DePoy is really helpful and knowledgable if you're interested or willing to learn. He posts lectures online, gives study guides for the tests, and gives opportunities for extra credit.

He just wants you to learn the material. He doesn't try to trick you or make you learn useless information you'll never need again. He really just wants you to be knowledgeable even if you're not going to major in astronomy.
